name: Burdening Sand
description: Let a mountain's weight of sand rest on a foe until every motion costs them their strength.

name: Crumbled Aegis
description: Wear a shield to powder with a thin hard stream of sand and strike through the powder.

name: Obscuring Dust
description: Raise a great dark dust that swallows sight and qi sense across the whole field.

name: Ruin Tide
description: Roll a tide of ruinous sand over a wide ground and flatten all that rises from it.

name: Absolving Sand
description: Let sand take a crushing blow into itself and bury the force in its depths.

name: Sand Passing
description: Pass the body through a barrier as a fall of sand through a sieve.

name: Wearing Flash
description: Wear a path through the air in a blink and stand at the end of it unmarked.

name: Reducing Touch
description: Lay a touch that wears at flesh and qi together and cannot be guarded against.

name: Sand Reign
description: Hold the whole field of sand in one hand and turn it upon the foes in a single sweep.

name: Dust Verdict
description: Pass a verdict in dust that seals a foe's qi and stance in place until it is lifted.

name: Eternal Grain
description: Strike with a single grain that carries the weight of all sand the user has ever held.

name: World Erosion
description: Wear the world's ground to dust over a reach no greater than the ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Endless Sand
description: The sand never runs low: every grain worn away is replaced from no source at all so the field is never emptied.

name: Unwearing
description: The dust remembers the shape it once held so everything worn from the field returns whole as it was.
